description: This file defines the MemoryStreamQueueGrain class, which implements a memory queue for event data with enqueue and dequeue operations, used within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: MemoryStreamQueueGrain
classes.description: A grain that functions as an in-memory event data queue with enqueue and dequeue capabilities, supporting maximum event count limit and migration participation.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds a MemoryMessageData item to the queue, incrementing sequence number, throws if maximum count is reached.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Retrieves up to maxCount items from the queue.

methods.name: OnDehydrate
methods.description: Stores the current queue state into the dehydration context for migration.

methods.name: OnRehydrate
methods.description: Restores the queue state from the rehydration context during migration.
